subject: music
topicDisplay: Area Of Study 4 Popular Music 1980 To Present
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: The 'blue notes' that give blues its distinctive sound are usually:
questions.explain: Blue notes are typically flattened 3rds, 5ths and 7ths, giving the bluesy feel.

questions.q: Which chords does a standard 12-bar blues use?
questions.explain: The 12-bar blues is built on the primary chords I, IV and V.

questions.q: Rock and pop since the 1960s is most associated with which line-up?
questions.explain: Modern rock and pop is typically built around guitars, bass, drums and vocals.

options: Making up music spontaneously, often over a chord sequence
questions.explain: Improvisation is creating music spontaneously, often soloing over a set chord sequence.

questions.q: Which group of instruments typically forms the 'rhythm section' of a band?
questions.explain: The rhythm section usually consists of drums, bass and a chordal instrument like guitar or keyboard.

questions.q: 'Walking bass' is a feature most associated with which style?
questions.explain: A walking bass line moving steadily in crotchets is a characteristic jazz feature.

questions.q: Reverb, delay and distortion are examples of audio:
questions.explain: Reverb, delay and distortion are audio effects used to alter a sound.

questions.q: A short, catchy repeated instrumental phrase in pop and rock is called a:
questions.explain: A riff is a short, repeated, catchy instrumental phrase, common in rock and pop.

options: Taking a section of an existing recording to reuse in a new track
questions.explain: Sampling takes a portion of an existing sound or recording and reuses it in a new piece.

options: Recording parts separately and layering them together
questions.explain: Multi-tracking records different parts separately and layers them into one final mix.

options: A catchy musical idea that grabs the listener
questions.explain: A hook is a memorable, catchy musical idea designed to grab the listener.

questions.q: In a pop song, the section that repeats with the same words and main 'hook' is the:
questions.explain: The chorus repeats with the same lyrics and usually contains the song's main hook.
